scenes.title: Only the Neighbour Next Door
scenes.summary: The Tuesday-night knock turns out to be a neighbour returning a misdelivered city envelope confirming Wednesday's three-o'clock visit.

scenes.title: General in an Apron
scenes.summary: At 6:00 AM Wednesday, Yuka sits with her ankle on pillows directing Daiki's bread kneading and Mio's lemon curd like a cheerful general.

scenes.title: Carrots by the Millimetre
scenes.summary: Haruto chops vegetables with architectural precision for the lentil soup while Daiki and Yuka tease him affectionately.

scenes.title: Setting Room Nine
scenes.summary: At half past two on Wednesday, Mio, Kazuko, and Kenji lay white linen cloths, stoneware cups, and small lemon branches on the tables in Room 9.

scenes.title: Put the Speech Away
scenes.summary: At 2:55 PM, Takashi nervously recites a stiff five-page history speech until Mio and Kenji convince him to simply welcome the visitor naturally.

scenes.title: The Heritage Stamp
scenes.summary: After inspecting the open gate, sunlit café tables, lending books, and hot tea, the heritage clerk signs the protection form—and asks Kazuko to play.

scenes.title: Toast in the Kitchen
scenes.summary: Listening to Kazuko's piano waltz from the kitchen doorway, Yuka, Haruto, and Daiki clink teacups to celebrate passing the review.

scenes.title: The Tune at the Gate
scenes.summary: At the courtyard gate, Takashi, Mio, and Kazuko learn the passerby was the violinist neighbor who used to play Friday duets with Takashi's aunt thirty years ago—and he promises to return Friday at six!
